column1: # firetime_allowlist.tsv — expiry-dated suppressions for firetime_check.py known-benign flags.
# Born 2026-07-11 (doc-audit 7/10 item 7, Will-approved) — replaces the SCRATCH §Cautions known-flags stopgap.
#   - artifact  = repo-relative path, must match the flagged artifact exactly.
#   - pattern   = literal substring that must appear in the flag text (not a regex).
#   - expires   = YYYY-MM-DD, MANDATORY. A row past its expiry stops suppressing and
#                 instead RAISES its own flag ("ALLOWLIST EXPIRED") — re-verify the
#                 underlying claim, then renew with a fresh expiry or delete the row.
#   - reason    = why the flag is benign — specific enough that a future reader can
# MAINTENANCE: PROME owns rows; adding/renewing a row = same bar as any canon claim
#   (verify the underlying fact first, cite it in reason). scripts/ is Will-scoped:
#   structural changes to this file's format go through Will.
